comments.author: Me
comments.body: This quest is repeatable and you get the armor every time, even if you have one equipped. It's the same with the quest called "Anecdote of a great king" from Amsterdam that gets you the Alexander the Great's sword and the quest called "God of War vs. god of war" from Athens that gets you the Scipio's helmet, you can repeat those quests while you have the quest item equipped and you still get the item from the quest, every time. Tbh, a King Richard I's armour, Scipio's helmet, Alexander the Great's sword along with Iron gloves, Iron greaves and a + Swordplay item like Koxinga papers makes a decent set of gear for things like doing melee battle grinding skills or Giza and Luxor mid level dungeons
